decisions.reason: As a recently launched coolant-system product that has already been publicly presented, it fits the firm's industrial portfolio and there is too little negative evidence after one year to justify reversing the investment.

The coolant cleaning centrifuge appears closely related to the firm's machinery-support offering, and a large German manufacturer would typically continue after launch rather than abandon a visible, fresh investment quickly.
Although coolant nozzles may require less sunk investment than larger equipment, the product is still new, publicly listed, and easy to defend as needing more time to gain market traction.
A scraper belt chip conveyor is a substantial, portfolio-consistent machine component, so prior development effort and public commitment make near-term withdrawal unlikely.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor likely involved meaningful engineering and signals strategic breadth in chip-handling solutions, which favors continued commitment despite limited time in market.
The hinged belt chip conveyor complements the firm's established machinery business, and escalation of commitment makes management likely to keep supporting it this soon after launch.
